name: Oregon Wire
old_description: At Oregon Wire we invest ourselves in being the wire manufacturer that does it right. We’re not just a supplier, we’re a partner you can trust and depend on. We also make sure we’re easy to work with, and have a customer service team that can get you what you need, when you need it.
about:
Oregon Wire was established in 1973 in Portland, Oregon, as an American manufacturer of wire products and agricultural solutions. The company has operated from its Portland base for over five decades, building a reputation for honesty and integrity in the steel wire supply industry.

The company produces a range of wire products including custom wire forms, trellis systems for commercial growers, baling wire for recycling operations, wire mesh and reinforcement products for construction, and wreath frames, floral wire, and garden supports for the wreath and garden market. Oregon Wire operates a manufacturing facility in Portland and maintains a network of custom wire form manufacturers to fulfill specialized projects. Specific facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not publicly disclosed.

Oregon Wire serves commercial growers, recycling facilities, construction contractors, industrial manufacturers, and both professional and hobbyist customers in the wreath and garden segment. The company supplies trellis systems and plant supports to growers, galvanized and black annealed baling wire to recycling operations, and durable wire mesh to construction projects. Its industrial wire solutions address manufacturing and packaging needs.

The company emphasizes flexibility, offering small-quantity orders, local pickup, warehouse services, and extended payment terms. It prioritizes locally sourced, American-made steel and recycled materials, and its customer service team provides updates on inventory, production schedules, and deliveries. Oregon Wire cites its decades of supply chain expertise as a differentiator, helping customers with cost control and inventory management.
